about.title: The cleaning company WeDo365
about.text: WeDo 365 AB is a seasoned cleaning firm located in Stockholm. With a committed team of skilled professionals and extensive industry expertise, we endeavor to provide high-quality, dependable service and outcomes that inspire pride – every day of the year. We clean homes, offices, gyms and properties in Stockholm.
about.text2: You have a personal contact with us before anything is booked.
about.why: We advocate for quality, reliability, and adaptability. Through expertly executed tasks, established quality protocols, and eco-friendly cleaning products, we strive to cultivate clean and inviting environments for our clients.
about.closing: With WeDo 365 AB, you gain a dependable cleaning partner dedicated to quality and service throughout the year.

legal.contactText: Questions about this page or your details? Get in touch:

privacy.lead: Here we explain what you share when you send a request, what we do with it, and what rights you have.

sections.title: What we receive
sections.text: What you fill in when you send a request. For home cleaning, move-out cleaning, deep cleaning and window cleaning: service, size of the home or number of windows, preferred frequency, preferred date and time, address, notes, name, email address and mobile number. For business quotes: type of premises, area, frequency, company or organisation, contact person, email address, phone number and message.

sections.title: Why we use the information and on what basis
sections.text:
We use the information to answer your request, for example with a suggested time and price, and to carry out the job if you become a customer.
The legal basis is taking steps at your request before a contract is made (Article 6.1.b of the General Data Protection Regulation, GDPR) and our legitimate interest in being able to answer enquiries (Article 6.1.f). If you become a customer we also process the information to fulfil the contract and to comply with the Swedish Accounting Act (Article 6.1.b and 6.1.c).

sections.title: What the website stores
sections.text: The website stores nothing itself. It has no database and does not keep what you send. Your request is sent to us as an email, and you get a copy.

sections.title: Our mailbox: Loopia
sections.text: Requests arrive in our mailbox, which is hosted by Loopia in Sweden. Loopia is a data processor for us.

sections.title: Hosting: Vercel
sections.text: The website is hosted by Vercel, which is a data processor for us. Vercel keeps standard server logs of visits to the website.

sections.title: Email service: Resend
sections.text: We send email with the Resend service (EU region), which is a data processor for us. What you send goes through Resend on its way to us and to you.

sections.title: Transfers outside the EU/EEA
sections.text: Vercel and Resend are US companies, so information may be handled outside the EU/EEA. According to what the providers state in their data processing agreements, such transfers rely on the European Commission's standard contractual clauses.

sections.title: How long we keep the information
sections.text:
We keep your request only as long as needed to answer it.
If you become a customer, we keep the information while the job is ongoing and afterwards for as long as the Accounting Act requires.
The website stores nothing itself. Vercel and Resend may keep technical logs for a limited time under their own terms.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.text:
You have the right to:
• find out what information we hold about you and get a copy (right of access)
• have incorrect information corrected
• have information erased
• ask us to restrict the processing
• object to processing based on our legitimate interest
• receive the information you gave us in a common format when the processing is based on a contract (data portability)
Contact us at {email} and we will reply within one month. You also have the right to complain to the Swedish Authority for Privacy Protection (IMY, imy.se).

sections.title: Links and cookies
sections.text: We link to our Facebook and Instagram pages (in the header and the footer). We embed nothing from them. The website sets no tracking cookies and uses no analytics with cookies. When you click a link you leave the website, and the other service's own policy applies.

sections.title: About the terms
sections.text: These terms apply to cleaning services from {company} (org. no. {orgNr}). Business customers receive a written quote, and if it differs from these terms, the quote applies.

sections.title: Requests and booking
sections.text: A request on the website is not a booking. We contact you with a price and confirm the time before anything is booked. The job is booked only once we have confirmed the time and price, by phone or email.

sections.title: Complaints
sections.text:
If you are not satisfied, contact us as soon as possible, so that we can put it right.
As a private customer you have rights under the Swedish Consumer Services Act that these terms do not limit.

sections.title: Liability and insurance
sections.text:
We have liability insurance with {insurer}. If we damage something during a job, tell us as soon as possible.
The policy number is not published here.

sections.title: Payment
sections.text: You pay by invoice after the job is done.

sections.title: Right of withdrawal
sections.text:
As a private customer you have a 14-day right of withdrawal when you buy a service at a distance. The period runs from the day the contract is made. Tell us clearly by email or phone that you withdraw.
If you want us to start before the withdrawal period has ended, you must expressly ask us to. If you withdraw after we have started, you pay for what has already been done. If we have performed the whole service at your express request and you have accepted that the right of withdrawal then ends, you can no longer withdraw.
The right of withdrawal does not apply to business customers.

sections.title: Disputes
sections.text: We always try to resolve a dispute directly with you. As a private customer you can also turn to the National Board for Consumer Disputes (Allmänna reklamationsnämnden, arn.se).
